－－－－
红面老者眉头一皱，不满道：“李长老，我们恒岳派难道真要下贱到如此地步？为了一个凡人的生死居然破例？”
李长老睁开双眼，声音渐冷，说道：“马长老，掌门说了，这事交给我等全权负责，若处理不好，这废物小子真自杀第二次，到时他父母宣扬出去，说我们恒岳派逼死他家孩子，这难堪的事情，难道就不下贱？你可以负责？若你负责，这事我就不管了。”
中年人连忙打圆场，说道：“好了，我们不要为了这点小事争吵，这样，就先把他收为记名弟子，等过了十年八年的，他修仙不成再送回去，如此一来也就没有日后的麻烦，岂不是妙哉？”
锦袍老者在一旁忽然说道：“若其他没被收取的孩子也效仿，我们该怎么办？”
中年人轻笑，说道：“这也好办，经过这次事情，我们也算有了教训，以后所有测试不合格的孩子，都一一用化神术点拨一番，种下不要轻生的念头，不就得了。至于这王林，既然已经闹到如此，干脆就收了吧，反正一个记名弟子，也无关大雅。”
除了李长老外，其余两个长老都用大有深意的目光看了眼中年人，不再言语。
中年人面带微笑，内心暗道：“王林啊王林，能帮的我都帮了，你四叔给我的那块精铁，我可就却之不恭了。我倒是很奇怪，一个凡人，居然能弄到这等材料。”
中年不知道，那块精铁，是王林四叔一次偶然间从一铁匠那里买来，他见多识广，一眼就看出不凡，这次为了能让铁柱加入恒岳派，于是抱着试一试的态度拿出，至于这宝贝的作用，他并不知晓。
一块精铁，改变了王林的命运，当这个消息传到他耳中时，王林都不敢相信，自己居然莫名其妙的被收为记名弟子。
两天后，他把父母送下恒岳派，望着父母兴奋的表情，王林内心也颇为喜悦，暗自决定踏踏实实的在这里修仙。
不过这样的想法，在他父母下山后，改变了，王林被叫到一处专门安排记名弟子工作的房屋，一个长相贼眉鼠眼的黄衣青年，面带轻蔑之色，上下打量了他一番，嘲笑道：“你就是那个靠自杀才成为记名弟子的王林？”
王林看了他一眼，沉默不语，青年眉毛一挑，冷笑道：“小子，从明天开始每日太阳一出就到我这里来报道，你的工作就是挑水，不足十大缸，就没有饭吃，若是连续七天一直不行，我会禀告长老，将你逐出恒岳派。这是你的衣服，的衣服。”说完，他不耐烦的把一套衣服以及腰牌仍在一旁，闭目养神不再理会对方。
王林拿起衣服，问道：“我住哪里？”
青年眼都没挣，漫不经心的说道：“向北走，自然会看到一排平屋，把腰牌给那里的弟子，就给你安排房间了。”
王林记在心里，转身向北走去，待他走后，青年睁开眼睛，蔑视的自语道：“居然靠自杀才加入进来，真是废物一个。”
走在恒岳派内，王林一路上看到的大部分弟子都是身穿灰衣，一个个行色匆匆，面色冷淡，有一些手中还拿着干活的工具，神情略显疲惫。
一直向北走了许久，终于看到一排矮矮的屋舍，这里灰衣弟子要比别处多了不少，但依然还是各行其事，彼此很少交谈。
把腰牌交给负责此地的黄衣弟子后，对方话都没说一句，不耐烦的指了一处屋舍。

王林也习惯了这里人人冷淡的表情，走到屋舍，推门进去一看，房间不大，两张木床、一张桌子，打扫的很干净，新旧程度和家里差不多。
他选了一个看起来无人使用的木床，把行李放好，这才躺在床上心里思绪万千，这恒岳派虽说终于进来了，可却并非如他想象那样可以修炼仙术，听之前那个黄衣青年的意思，自己的工作是挑水。
想到这里，他轻叹一声，摸了摸怀中用绳子绑在胸前的石珠，这个东西可是他极为在意的宝贝，王林读书多，知道很多典故，其中就包括匹夫无罪怀璧其罪的事情，他暗下决心，不能让任何人知道自己有这个宝贝。

The red-faced old man frowned and said dissatisfied: "Elder Li, do we, the Hengyue Sect, really want to stoop so low? To make an exception for the sake of a mortal's life and death?"
Elder Li opened his eyes, his voice became colder, and said: "Elder Ma, the leader has said that I will be fully responsible for this matter. If it is not handled well, this good-for-nothing kid will commit suicide for the second time. Then his parents will spread the word and say that our Hengyue Sect forced his child to death. Isn't this embarrassing thing despicable? Can you take responsibility? If you are responsible, I will ignore this matter."
The middle-aged man quickly reconciled and said: "Okay, let's not quarrel over this trivial matter. In this way, let's accept him as a registered disciple first. After ten or eight years, he will be sent back if he fails to cultivate immortality. In this way, there will be no trouble in the future. Wouldn't it be wonderful?"
The old man in brocade robes suddenly said from the side: "What should we do if other children who have not been adopted also follow suit?"
The middle-aged man chuckled and said, "This is easy to handle. After this incident, we have learned a lesson. From now on, all the children who fail the test will use the spirit transformation technique to teach them one by one and plant the idea not to commit suicide. As for Wang Lin, since the trouble has gone so far, let's just accept it. Anyway, being a registered disciple is not important."
Except for Elder Li, the other two elders looked at the middle-aged man with profound eyes and said nothing.
The middle-aged man smiled and said to himself: "Wang Lin, Wang Lin, I've helped with everything I can. I'm so disrespectful of the piece of fine iron your fourth uncle gave me. I'm surprised that a mortal can actually get such materials."
The middle-aged man didn't know that the piece of fine iron was accidentally bought by Wang Lin's fourth uncle from a blacksmith. He was well-informed and could tell that it was extraordinary at a glance. This time, in order to get Tie Zhu to join the Heng Yue Sect, he took it out with the attitude of giving it a try. As for the function of this treasure, he did not know.
A piece of fine iron changed Wang Lin's destiny. When the news reached his ears, Wang Lin couldn't believe that he had been accepted as a registered disciple for no reason.
Two days later, he sent his parents off to the Hengyue Sect. Looking at his parents' excited expressions, Wang Lin felt quite happy in his heart, and secretly decided to cultivate immortality here in a down-to-earth manner.
However, this idea changed after his parents came down from the mountain. Wang Lin was called to a house where registered disciples were assigned to work. A young man in yellow with a sinister look on his face looked at him up and down with disdain and said mockingly: "Are you the Wang Lin who committed suicide to become a registered disciple?"
Wang Lin glanced at him and remained silent. The young man raised his eyebrows and sneered: "Boy, from tomorrow onwards you will report to me every day as soon as the sun rises. Your job is to carry water. If you don't carry water for ten large tanks, you will have no food. If you can't do it for seven days in a row, I will report to the elders and expel you from the Hengyue Sect. These are your clothes, my clothes." After saying that, he impatiently put a set of clothes and waist tag aside, closed his eyes and paid no attention to the other party.
Wang Lin picked up his clothes and asked, "Where should I live?"
The young man said casually without blinking, "Go north and you will naturally see a row of bungalows. Give your badge to the disciple there and I will arrange a room for you."
Wang Lin remembered it in his mind, turned around and walked north. After he left, the young man opened his eyes and said to himself contemptuously: "You actually committed suicide to join. What a loser."
Walking in the Hengyue Sect, most of the disciples Wang Lin saw along the way were dressed in gray clothes. They were all walking in a hurry and had cold faces. Some of them still had working tools in their hands and looked slightly tired.
Have been walking north for a long timeAfter a long time, I finally saw a row of low houses. There were many more gray-clothed disciples here than elsewhere, but they still went about their own business and rarely talked to each other.
After handing the waist card to the disciple in yellow who was in charge of this place, the other party pointed to a house impatiently without saying a word.
Wang Lin was also used to the indifferent expressions of everyone here. He walked to the house, opened the door and took a look. The room was not big, with two wooden beds and a table. It was very clean and the condition was similar to that at home.
He chose a wooden bed that seemed to be unused, put his luggage away, and then lay on the bed with a lot of thoughts in his mind. Although the Hengyue Sect finally came in, it was not as good as he imagined. According to the young man in yellow, his job was to carry water.
Thinking of this, he sighed softly and touched the stone bead tied to his chest with a rope. This thing was a treasure that he cared about very much. Wang Lin read a lot and knew many allusions, including the story of a man who was not guilty and had a stone in his possession. He secretly made up his mind not to let anyone know that he had this treasure.
